gre_general.value: GRE General scores are optional; all applications are reviewed whether or not GRE scores are submitted.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are OPTIONAL for those applying to the PhD Program. All applications will be reviewed whether or not GRE scores are included.

also.quote: the reporting of GRE scores is OPTIONAL for those applying to the program. All applications will be reviewed whether or not GRE scores are included.

gre_subject.value: The GRE Psychology Subject Test is not required.
gre_subject.quote: The psychology subject test is not required.

supervisor.value: Neither the Graduate Catalog nor the Neuroscience & Behavior application pages state whether pre-admission faculty supervisor contact or confirmation is required.

funding.value: Competitive UNO Graduate Assistantships (20 hrs/week, monthly salary, tuition waiver up to 12 credits/semester, subsidized health insurance; limited to 6 semesters beyond a master's).
funding.quote: As a graduate assistant you will be considered a UNO employee with a tuition waiver, monthly salary, and subsidized health insurance. | doctoral students are limited to six (6) semesters beyond their master's degree.

also.quote: GAs are selected by each department individually, so please contact your department's office to apply.

entry_route.value: 90-credit doctoral track accommodating applicants entering directly with a bachelor's degree (earning an M.A. en route at UNO before advancing to candidacy in Year 4–5) or entering with a prior master's degree (30–45 credits transferred).
entry_route.quote: Credit from Masters (30-45 hrs); 4 field-related courses; 1 other (ROTT); Dissertations hours | Students earnings a MA at UNO, this would be the end of your 4th year or beginning of 5th; Students arriving with a master's earned elsewhere, this would be by the end of your 3rd year

also.quote: Minimum GPA of at least 3.0 in undergraduate courses related to proposed major

notes: Neuroscience and Behavior Concentration within UNO's 90-credit Psychology Ph.D. (in collaboration with UNMC, Boys Town National Research Hospital, and Henry Doorly Zoo). Requires 3 letters of recommendation, statement of purpose, writing sample (APA style preferred), and CV/resume. UNO Psychology Ph.D. also offers Developmental Psychology and Industrial/Organizational Psychology concentrations (excluded as non-STEM/applied).
name: Psychology, Ph.D. (Neuroscience and Behavior)
